name: @fyeeme/pi-virtual-model
description: Model selection routing for pi: the glm-5.3-auto virtual model switches between glm-5.3 and glm-5.3-flash by image presence, and the session model is picked by Beijing wall-clock time (glm-5.3-flash in the 14:00-18:00 window, glm-5.3-auto otherwise).
author: fyeeme
